args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following the v2.3.1 production deploy. Per the runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: service is healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with a 0.2% error rate. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the failed health checks is investigated and fixed.
